content: विघातः .²1 Destruction, removing, warding off; क्रियादघानां मघवा विघातम् <ls>Ki. 3. 52</ls>. .²2 Killing, slaying. .²3 An obstacle, impediment, interruption; opposition, prevention; क्रियाविघाताय कथं प्रवर्तसे <ls>R. 3. 44</ls>; अध्वरविघातशान्तये <ls n="R.">11. 1</ls>. .²4 A blow, stroke. .²5 Abandoning, leaving. .²6 Failure, want of success.
